response.text: Invoice 118 has INV_AMT 2666.76, but journal 1192 recorded 2693.76 on both sides, so the expense and AP Control are each overstated by 27.00. The correction reverses that overstatement: credit 5500 Travel 27.00 and debit 2000 AP Control 27.00. Together with the original journal, the group balances and nets to 2666.76 on each account. Period 6 is closed, so the lines go in open period 11. No invoice status changes, because this is not a duplicate_invoice finding. Invoice 655 is outside this finding's scope, as the finding was split to cover invoice 118 only.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 1192 recorded invoice 118 at 2693.76 instead of 2666.76, overstating expense 5500 and AP Control 2000 by 27.00. The correcting journal debits 2000 and credits 5500 for 27.00 in open period 11, because period 6 is closed. The original plus the correction nets to 2666.76 on each account and balances. No invoice status is changed.
